meta.name: Stingray Classica
meta.description:
Discover breathtaking classical music concerts, operas, and ballets from some of the grandest venues around the world.

Shows: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra, Ludwig Wicki, Danish National Symphony Orchestra, DR Junior Choir & Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger, Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra, Ana María Paño-Osorio & Philharmonie de Paris
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
